title: Quaintly Roasted Italian Vegetable Ribollita
description: A hearty and comforting Italian dish featuring roasted vegetables and star anise, perfect for a cold winter evening. This ribollita is a traditional Lombard recipe with a twist, using roasted vegetables for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped carrots, celery, and onions with olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large pot, saute the minced garlic over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, and ground star anise to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the roasted vegetables, chopped kale, and cubed bread to the pot, stirring to combine.
Continue to simmer the ribollita for an additional 10 minutes, or until the bread is broken down and the soup has thickened.
Season the ribollita with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
